one_liner: Google's AI notebook for querying and summarizing your documents
blocker: API requires paid Gemini Notebook Enterprise licenses plus org admin setup (IdP, IAM roles); no free/self-serve consumer API

evidence.claim: API calls authenticate with Google Cloud OAuth2 access tokens sent as Bearer headers
Official REST API exists but is limited to notebook management tasks
evidence.quote: This page describes the APIs that let you perform the following notebook management tasks programmatically

evidence.claim: Licenses are a paid per-user subscription
evidence.quote: $9 USD per license per month with discounted option for yearly subscriptions

evidence.claim: The API is gated behind the Enterprise product with identity setup and a subscription
evidence.quote: The NotebookLM API requires Google Cloud's NotebookLM Enterprise product which requires identity/auth setup and buying a subscription.

evidence.claim: The consumer NotebookLM product has no self-serve API key
evidence.quote: The consumer NotebookLM product does not offer a self-serve public API key.

notes: API is v1alpha preview hosted on discoveryengine.googleapis.com; documented surface is notebook create/get/list/delete/share plus a podcast-generation method. Setup demands a Cloud org admin (Cloud NotebookLM Admin role) and IdP config (Cloud Identity or Workforce Identity Federation), though licenses are purchasable self-serve in the console. No official MCP server from Google; community servers (e.g., PleasePrompto/notebooklm-mcp) automate a real Chrome session against the consumer UI instead.
